newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GOLF-MCNULTY AND PRICE HEAD SOUTH AFRICAN PRO-AM FIELD.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-MCNULTY AND PRICE HEAD SOUTH AFRICAN PRO-AM FIELD.

text.p: Zimbabweans Mark McNulty and Nick Price and Irish player Padraig Harrington are among the biggest names in the field for the pro-am golf tournament at Sun City from February 13-16, organisers said on Tuesday.

The event, co-sponsored for the second year running by the Southern African and European tours, has a weakened field by normal European standards with only five players from last year's top 20 on the tour Order of Merit.
Colin Montgomerie, Nick Faldo, Ian Woosnam, Bernhard Langer, Robert Allenby and Costantino Rocca will all be missing but defending champion McNulty and Price will give the event much-needed class.
The 43-year-old McNulty finished fifth on last year's European Order of Merit, with his season's highlight a remarkable seven-stroke win in the prestigious Masters at Valderrama.
McNulty has since won three successive events on the Southern African tour and is in the best form of his career.
Price, the former British Open and U.S. PGA champion, has generally played well at Sun City and he seems to be recovering his golfing touch after struggling with sinus trouble for much of last year.
Harrington, a 25-year-old former Walker Cup player, is one of the rising stars of European golf and finished 11th on last year's Order of Merit after several consistent placings and a first-time win.
